text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby gives off an unusually 
spirited aura today... What should I say 
to her—
choice_data_list: Let's show them how strong you are.

Let's show them just what you're capable 
of.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, that is my intention. To let 
the world know my supreme form—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Because that is the duty I was born with.
